label: ① 冷白精选展陈
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity DESKTOP HOMEPAGE design image for "proof of cake", a niche onchain birthday art-gifting platform. Landscape 1536x1024, edge-to-edge web content, no device/browser mockup and no physical shop interior. The visitor should feel they have entered an exceptionally curated independent luxury boutique, NOT a marketplace, bazaar, dashboard, image search or shopping catalogue. Luxury here means exact proportions, strong curation, quiet confidence, ample purposeful space and beautiful typography, not gold, marble, black-and-gold decoration or status claims.

CRITICAL: platform identity and artwork style are independent. Reference image 1 is the tall Chinese ink sheep artwork; reference image 2 supplies other mixed artwork contents ONLY, never its busy marketplace UI. Present only TWO OR THREE carefully selected works in the opening viewport, with a clear editorial relationship. Include the sheep painting and at least one contrasting colorful pixel birthday or colorful cartoon work from the second reference, with their own colors and native proportions intact. Never recolor the artworks or make every work match the boutique palette. Their diversity should look intentional, like different artists exhibited by one excellent curator. No grid of equal product cards. No tag clouds, filter pills, badges, checkmarks, visible cart, recipient/date checkout forms, loud buy buttons, excessive hairlines or fake scarcity. Move detailed selection mentally beyond the calm homepage.

The page must read as an actual usable birthday ART GIFTING website rather than a poster. A distinctive restrained wordmark "proof of cake", minimal real navigation "作品", "关于", and "连接钱包". One short honest Chinese line "为一个人，珍藏一份心意。" and a discreet clear action "挑选生日礼物". If an artwork title is needed, the sheep is "今天不数羊". Small "设计预览" may sit at the page edge. Show the beginning of a next collection or story below the opening to establish a considered journey, not a wall of inventory. No invented artists, editions, prices, years, social proof or exclusive membership claims. Crisp text, mature independent art direction.
Direction: cool-white curated exhibition. The site's signature is an exceptionally controlled editorial frame: custom elegant contemporary typography, precise but generous margins, one commanding art placement and a smaller contrasting work in a deliberate asymmetrical conversation. Neither artwork becomes a full-screen wallpaper. Cold white and quiet graphite are the entire interface; artwork supplies all color. Let the site feel expensive through the ratio of empty space to meaningful content and exquisite alignment, not ornamental serif excess or generic split-headline hero. The short invitation and gifting link are integrated gently with the art. The persistent brand and navigation stay modest, confident and unmistakable. Digital luxury boutique for art, with enough specificity to survive replacing the images.
